candidates.author: Nikolay Bochev
candidates.prompt: Design an app icon for Blackgrid, a Windows desktop companion for an extraction shooter. It shows interactive raid maps and scans in-game items to say whether to keep or sell them. The mood is dark, tactical and utilitarian: think a field map grid or a scanner reticle, not a cartoon. Requirements:  1024×1024 square PNG with a transparent background. No text or letters. No game logos, and nothing copied from any game's artwork. One bold shape that is still recognisable at 16×16 px. Keep fine detail to a minimum and use thick strokes. Two or three colours at most, with strong contrast that reads on both light and dark taskbars. Give me 4 distinct concepts.
